hero.headline: Industrial Commissioning,
hero.subheadline: Digitize ITRs, Punch Lists, Certificates, Preservation and KPIs in a single cloud-native platform — built for Oil & Gas, LNG, renewables, mining and heavy industry projects.

problem.title: Commissioning is still managed with tools that weren't designed for the field.
problem.card1Title: Scattered ITRs with no reliable document control
problem.card1Desc: Checklists across folders, binders, WhatsApp photos and emails. No traceability, no single source, no audit trail.
problem.card2Title: Punch Lists without a single source of truth
problem.card2Desc: Multiple Excel files, outdated data and no unified tracking. Real project progress is unknown until it's too late.
problem.card3Title: Certificates issued without blocking critical deficiencies
problem.card3Desc: No automatic blocking logic. Cat A punches reaching operations — causing costly rework and startup delays.

howItWorks.title: From Field Execution to Handover Dossier
howItWorks.step1Desc: Each piece of equipment is registered with a live tag in CommUp.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The technician scans on their phone — no additional app needed.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Fill out the checklist, attach photos, capture signature on screen.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Auto-blocked until all Cat A punches are resolved. One click, full traceability.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Complete package: ITRs, certificates, punch history and digital signatures — ready for client handover.

differentiators.title: Built for field teams. Trusted by project governance.
differentiators.nfcDesc: Access the full tag history in one second. Zero friction.
differentiators.cloudDesc: No servers, no installations, always updated. Works from anywhere.
differentiators.realtimeDesc: Every completed ITR or closed punch reflected instantly for the whole team.
differentiators.securityDesc: Each company and project completely isolated by design. Your data is yours alone — with full role-based access control and audit trail.

industries.title: Built for the most demanding projects

cta.title: Start your next commissioning project with full traceability from day one.
cta.subtitle: Join the teams delivering projects faster, with fewer errors and complete handover documentation.
cta.trustLine: Guided demo · Assisted initial setup · No commercial commitment

socialProof.title: Common commissioning challenges CommUp is built to solve
socialProof.s1Desc: Paper checklists, phone photos, emailed signatures — no traceability. CommUp centralizes every ITR with a full digital audit trail, accessible from any device.
socialProof.s2Title: Punch Lists without automatic certificate blocking
socialProof.s2Desc: Cat A deficiencies reaching operations because nothing prevented certificate issuance. CommUp enforces hard blocks: no certificate until all critical punches are resolved.
socialProof.s3Title: No real-time visibility for project management
socialProof.s3Desc: Project managers waiting for Monday's manual Excel reports. CommUp delivers live KPI dashboards by system, area, discipline and phase — always current.
